title: Mirrors
subtitle: A sci-fi ghost story with a colder, more deliberate sense of haunting.
description: A three-thread horror drama moving across centuries, using one haunting to connect women, memory, and long-range consequence.

length.label: Official site describes the complete series as available now.

archiveTake: A good step up when the listener wants eerie atmosphere without sacrificing the speculative-fiction spine.

similarReasons.the-white-vault: Keeps the dread serious while shifting the haunting toward a broader speculative frame.
similarReasons.archive-81: A more ritual-heavy horror branch if the sound-driven weirdness is what you want more of.
similarReasons.ars-paradoxica: A cleaner science-fiction neighbor if the time-spanning structure mattered as much as the atmosphere.
